description: Nash M5Score weights. Weighted by how hard each signal is to fake: verified, system-observed signals count most; opinion signals are capped. PROPOSED: scores are computed and published for transparency but drive no fees, rebates or penalties until approved.

prior.note: Beta-reputation prior; a component with no signals scores scale*alpha/(alpha+beta) = 500.

decay.algorithm: weight(age_days) = Q32 square-and-multiply of daily_factor, flooring (>> 32) after every multiplication; age_days = floor((as_of - signal_at) seconds / 86400).

tier_status: UNSET: PLATINUM/GOLD/GOLD_CONDITIONAL/SILVER/WATCH thresholds require Chief Sovereign Architect approval; REMOVE remains the manual exclusion registry.
recalibration: Recalibrate from observed evidence as a new version; prior versions remain published.
